## macOS installation or update

This independent beta is not yet signed and notarized through Apple’s paid Developer Program. macOS may therefore say Apple could not verify that the app is free of malware. This means Apple has not notarized the build; it does **not** mean macOS detected malware.

1. Open the DMG and drag **MIDI to TD-3** into **Applications**. For an update, choose **Replace**.
2. Try to open the copy in **Applications** once and close the macOS warning.
3. Open **Apple menu → System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
4. Scroll to **Security**, click **Open Anyway**, authenticate, and confirm **Open**.

Only manually approve a DMG downloaded from the official repository. See the [complete macOS installation and update guide](https://github.com/timefracture/midi-to-td3-downloads/blob/main/MACOS_INSTALLATION.md).

Make a complete SynthTribe backup before using direct TD-3 transfer.
